TaskDescription: Delayed memory-guided action task: fixation (1.9-2.1 s), encoding (2 s; one object, triangle or square, shown at one of several positions), jittered delay (3.9-4.1 s), action/recall (2 s; joystick reach to the remembered position). Condition 2 'same' (remember position) / 3 'different' (remember position and identity, followed by a 2-alternative button question). Blocks of 10 trials; training trials first.
InstitutionName: Motol University Hospital, Motol Epilepsy Center
ManufacturersModelName: Quantum, NeuroWorks (medical amplifiers named in Moraresku et al. 2025)

Downsampling.Description: Recorded at 2048 Hz, downsampled to 512 Hz by the authors

NotchFilter.Description: 4th-order Butterworth band-stop, 1 Hz wide, centred at 50 Hz and harmonics, zero phase (authors)

iEEGReference: Bipolar derivations between adjacent contacts (authors). Recording reference: a white-matter contact per patient.
iEEGElectrodeInfo: Semi-rigid depth electrodes, diameter 0.8 mm, 8-18 contacts of 2 mm length, 1.5 mm apart; 11-15 electrodes per patient
iEEGPlacementScheme: Stereotactic depth electrodes placed solely for clinical pre-surgical evaluation
